title: CUSTOMS AGENCY LICENSE 2026 - Uganda Revenue Authority
text:
# CUSTOMS AGENCY LICENSE 2026
Pursuant to Section 145 (1) of the East African Community Customs Management Act, 2004 (as amended) and Regulation 149 – 152 of the East African Community Customs Management Regulations, 2010, the Commissioner Customs of the Uganda Revenue Authority invites new applicants and applications for renewal of Customs Agency Licenses for the Year 2026.
The applications form (form No. C20), licensing conditions and assessment forms are accessible via https://singlewindow.go.ug/stp/#/
All applicants are advised to ensure that the electronic application is duly completed, ,and that all the relevant information and documents as indicated on the Electronic Single Windows platform, are availed, scanned and uploaded to https://singlewindow.go.ug/stp/#/ not later than October 01, 2025.
Authorised Economic Operators (AEO) companies will only be required to submit applications for automatic renewal of their Customs Agency License subject to payment of the requisite fees.
The activities related to licensing will be conducted strictly within the timelines below;
Activity
Receiving Applications and payment of Application fee
September 01, 2025 – October 01, 2025
Competence test for Declarants
October 27, 2025
Vetting applications
September 01 – November 01, 2025
Appeals for review
October 16 – November 16, 2025
Final Verification and payment of License fee
September 01 – March 31, 2026
Closing date for issuance of licenses
March 31, 2026
First date of publication: Friday, August 22, 2025.
